hero.eyebrow: Microsoft Fabric · Data Platforms · Business Intelligence
hero.title: From complex data to a platform your organisation can trust.
hero.intro: Harrewijn Data helps organisations design, build and improve modern data platforms. Strategy and architecture are connected directly to implementation, so teams get reliable data, clear reporting and a foundation that can scale.

services_intro.title: Advice that gets implemented.
services_intro.text: From architecture to adoption, I combine hands-on engineering with consulting so the solution works technically and in the organisation.

services.title: Data strategy & architecture
services.text: Turn business goals into a pragmatic target architecture, roadmap and governance model for your data platform.

services.title: Microsoft Fabric implementation
services.text: Build governed, scalable Fabric platforms with reusable ingestion, medallion architecture, quality controls and CI/CD.

services.title: BI & decision support
services.text: Create semantic models and Power BI solutions that give teams one trusted view of performance and decisions.

services.title: Data quality & governance
services.text: Make ownership, lineage, security and data quality part of daily operations instead of an afterthought.

proof.title: Built in real organisations, not just on slides.
proof.text: Experience spans healthcare, public services, childcare, manufacturing, logistics and construction — from greenfield platforms to complex migrations.

featured_cases.title: A governed Fabric platform for reliable operational insight
featured_cases.text: Designed and implemented a Microsoft Fabric data platform with dimensional modelling, row-level security, automated data quality checks, scorecard reporting and end-user enablement.
featured_cases.result: Four reporting domains — Care, HR, Finance and Quality — brought onto one governed platform, including management reporting based on the Balanced Scorecard.

featured_cases.title: One data foundation across seven government partners
featured_cases.text: Led the redesign of a centralised Fabric data warehouse, aligning platform choices with public-sector standards, governance requirements and a roadmap toward Purview.
featured_cases.result: Requirements from multiple autonomous public-sector partners were harmonised into one functional design and one technical direction.

featured_cases.title: From source systems to governed reporting in Fabric
featured_cases.text: Delivered an end-to-end data warehouse and Power BI implementation with metadata-driven pipelines, medallion architecture, governance and operational monitoring.
featured_cases.result: Multiple business domains and reports were consolidated onto one central reusable data model with live data-quality monitoring.

approach.title: Clear direction. Short feedback loops. Transfer to your team.

about.title: Jonan Harrewijn
about.lead: Data engineering and BI specialist focused on Microsoft Fabric, Azure and Power BI.
about.text: I work at the intersection of architecture, engineering and stakeholder needs. My background in Operations Management & Logistics helps me translate operational questions into practical data solutions, while my technical work focuses on robust pipelines, dimensional models, governance and reporting.

cta.title: Let’s turn it into a concrete next step.
cta.text: Whether you are starting with Microsoft Fabric, modernising an existing platform or improving BI reliability, I’m happy to discuss the situation and what a sensible approach looks like.
